performance.verdict: Build is 57 days overdue; no campaigns should scale until stack is verified.

findings.text: 5 of 9 SOW milestones due July 31 are overdue 57 days: stack test, GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta CAPI, and landing pages/tracking — all unconfirmed complete.
4 additional milestones due Aug 31–Sep 1 also overdue: Meta reactivation lanes, Search campaigns, LSA verification, and GHL nurture sequences — none confirmed live.
Zero-spend days on Sep 25 ($0.53) and Sep 26 ($0), halting a 5-day surge that peaked at $68.23 on Sep 23 — delivery gap, not budget exhaustion.
3-day lead signal (Sep 22–24: 11, 20, 14 = avg 15) vs prior 3 days (Sep 19–21: 2, 7, 4 = avg 4.3) is a 3.5x step up — but spend also tripled, so CPL held near $5.23 baseline.
GBP actions fell -64% week-over-week (from ~18 to ~7 in last 7 days) while GA4 sessions fell -40%; organic is cooling despite no visible paid organic conflict — worth watching.

suggestions.text: Investigate and restore Meta delivery immediately — spend dropped to $0 Sep 25–26, killing 15 leads/day momentum.
suggestions.monday_update: Spend collapsed from $57.93 on Sep 23 to $0.53 on Sep 25 and $0 on Sep 26, interrupting a period averaging 15 leads/day at ~$5.23 CPL. Check Meta account for billing hold, ad set rejection, or campaign pause — restore delivery to the $40–$50/day level that produced the peak lead volume. Success check: spend resumes ≥$35/day and leads return by Sep 29.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 9 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer — no scale decisions are defensible until stack test and tracking are confirmed live.
suggestions.monday_update: 9 milestones spanning stack test, GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta CAPI, landing pages, search campaigns, LSA, and nurture sequences are between 26 and 57 days overdue as of Sep 26. GA4 shows 0 conversions across 3,341 sessions and GHL pipeline is null — attribution is dark, meaning the 95 leads captured have no verified downstream path. Nacer to provide completion status on each item by Sep 30; Phase 1 proof-of-concept cannot be assessed without confirmed tracking.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions; -64% weekly drop alongside -40% GA4 sessions may indicate organic audience fatigue or a profile issue.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell -64% week-over-week and GA4 sessions fell -40%, with the last 3 days of series data showing near-zero GBP activity. This is hypothesis-grade — no confirmed cause yet. Re-check on Sep 30 after Meta delivery is restored to separate paid traffic spillover from a genuine organic drop. Flag if GBP actions remain below 5 for the week ending Oct 3.
